Title: Concept drift detection in image data stream: a survey on current literature, limitations and future directions
Takeaway: This survey reviews concept drift detection methods for image data streams, categorizes them based on key properties, and highlights strengths and limitations, identifying promising future research directions.
Authors: Quang-Tien Tran, Nhien-An Le-Khac, Michela Bertolotto

Title: Performance Drift Detection in Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) for IoT Environments
Takeaway: The proposed MLaaS Performance Drift Detection framework for IoT environments improves performance drift detection accuracy by up to 22-25% and reduces miss detection rates by 9% compared to fixed-interval monitoring.
Authors: Deepak Kanneganti, Sajib Mistry, S. Fattah, Erik Elmroth, Aneesh Krishna, Monowar Bhuyan
Journal: IEEE Transactions on Network and Service Management
